# Immobilienscout24.de Scraper

<!-- This README is generated by .github/scripts/docs.py from the scraper code, its results/ folder and .github/scrapers.json: change those and run the script instead of editing it. -->

[![tests](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/raw/ci-status/badges/immobilienscout24-scraper.svg)](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/blob/ci-status/status/immobilienscout24-scraper.md)

Example scraper that collects property listing data from Immobilienscout24.de, written in Python with the [Scrapfly](https://scrapfly.io/) web scraping API. Part of [scrapfly-scrapers](../README.md).

- **Guide:** [How to Scrape Immobilienscout24.de Real Estate Data](https://scrapfly.io/blog/posts/how-to-scrape-immobilienscout24)
- **Code:** [`immobilienscout24.py`](immobilienscout24.py) · **Example run:** [`run.py`](run.py) · **Tests:** [`test.py`](test.py)
- **Sample output:** [Property pages](results/properties.json) · [Search pages](results/search.json)

## What it scrapes

- Immobilienscout24 property search for finding property listings
- Immobilienscout24 property pages for property listing data

## Functions

- `scrape_search(url, scrape_all_pages, max_scrape_pages=10)` → `List[Dict]`: scrape immobilienscout24 search pages
- `scrape_properties(urls)` → `List[Dict]`: scrape listing data from immoscout24 proeprty pages

The functions are `async`: run them with `asyncio.run(...)` or `await` them.

### Example

The inputs are the examples of [`run.py`](run.py) (long lists cut short):

```python
import asyncio
import immobilienscout24


async def main():
    search = await immobilienscout24.scrape_search(
        url="https://www.immobilienscout24.de/Suche/de/bayern/muenchen/wohnung-mieten",
        scrape_all_pages=False,
        max_scrape_pages=3,
    )
    properties = await immobilienscout24.scrape_properties(
        urls=[
            "https://www.immobilienscout24.de/expose/160519246#/",
            "https://www.immobilienscout24.de/expose/162617109#/",
        ],
    )


asyncio.run(main())
```

## Output

The functions return plain dictionaries and lists. Fields of the sample output (top-level keys of the first item):

- [`results/properties.json`](results/properties.json): `id`, `title`, `description`, `address`, `propertyLlink`, `propertySepcs`, `price`, `building`, `attachments`, `agencyName`, `agencyAddress`
- [`results/search.json`](results/search.json): `@id`, `@modification`, `@creation`, `@publishDate`, `realEstateId`, `disabledGrouping`, `resultlist.realEstate`, `attributes`, `realEstateTags`, `liveVideoTourAvailable`, `hasNewFlag`

## Scrapfly settings

`BASE_CONFIG` in [`immobilienscout24.py`](immobilienscout24.py) holds the default settings of the requests, see the [Scrape API documentation](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/getting-started):

- `unblocker` = `True`: Scrapfly's [Unblocker](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/unblocker), its anti-bot bypass
- `country` = `"de"`: country of the proxy

## Quick start

Requires Python 3.10+ and [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation).

```shell
git clone https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers.git
cd scrapfly-scrapers/immobilienscout24-scraper
export SCRAPFLY_KEY="YOUR SCRAPFLY KEY"   # from https://scrapfly.io/dashboard
poetry install --no-root
poetry run python run.py                  # example scrape, saves its output in ./results
poetry run pytest test.py                 # the tests of this scraper
```

Tests: `test_properties_scraping`, `test_search_scraping`; run one with `poetry run pytest test.py -k <test>`. `run.py` and the tests scrape the live website, so they use Scrapfly credits.
